waivers.verdict: Claim Devaughn Vele now; a smaller speculative claim on Michael Mayer (dropping Jakobi Meyers) is optional.

lineup.verdict: Nothing to change — Week 1 is final, all ten starters played, and you won 141.2–100.74.

trades.verdict: Two trades worth sending: Cousins + Meyers to Tally241 for Aaron Jones, and Bryce Young to amandaberry for Brian Robinson.

inactives.verdict: Nothing to check — Week 1 is over and Week 2 games are still days out.

actions.name: Devaughn Vele
actions.why: Vele is New Orleans's real WR2 by role with Tyson out, and the best add on this week's board.

actions.name: Michael Mayer
actions.why: Mayer's expanded role may only last as long as Bowers is out, so it's a smaller speculative bid.

actions.message: Hey — I've got more QB depth than I need and saw you're thin behind Maye/Nix. Would you do Kirk Cousins + Jakobi Meyers for Aaron Jones? Cousins is Vegas's actual Week 1 starter, so it's a real QB2/bye-week option for you, not a stash. I could use another back with an actual role given how thin my RB room is right now.
actions.why: Cousins is a real starting QB for a team with no backup, and it turns your extra depth into a running back with an actual role.

actions.message: You're carrying zero backup QB behind Lawrence/Love — I've got extra arms. Would you take Bryce Young for Brian Robinson? He's a real handcuff play for you and I could use another running back given how thin my bench is there right now.
actions.why: A cheaper fallback shot at the same running back fix, costing only your lowest-value quarterback stash.
